title: 第4章 新系统
novel_title: 恶毒女配又装纯，禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
又来？

    和铃有些懵了。

    干什么呢，把她识海当垃圾场了吗？

    有一个狗东西舔着脸不肯走就算了，现在又来一个未知系统，她真的无语。

    狗系统也很惊慌：【和铃，这入侵系统绝对不是什么好东西，你表现得抗拒点，不要接受它。】

    【我们绑定在一起，一荣俱荣，一损俱损，这世上，只有我是不会害你的，也只有我会与你同进退……】

    和铃已经无心听狗系统说什么了。

    她的脑海里面响起另外一道柔和的声音。

    【不等价交易系统已复苏，检测到宿主神魂附着陌生系统，请宿主选择是否交易。】

    和铃眼睛一亮。

    新系统能发卖狗系统？

    她立马道：“交易交易！”

    狗系统都惊呆了。

    哪来的小三统，居然还想发卖它这个原配系统！

    宿主跟着它胡闹，是以为她真的能甩开自己吗？

    哼，天真。

    哼，可笑。

    但下一秒，狗系统就笑不出来了。

    它感觉自己像是被狗咬了一口，然后能量体就缺了一部分。

    【系统能量不足，交易中止……】

    提示音响起，和铃皱了皱眉。

    “不能直接把它卖了吗？”

    交易系统愧疚地说道：【是的。】

    狗系统刚松了一口气，就听见和铃问道：“那你要怎样才能拥有发卖它的能量呢？”

    狗系统心中警铃大作，【和铃！你不要被它所迷惑了，一旦你帮助它成长起来，它对宿主提出的要求未必没有我过分，你小心养虎为患了。】

    和铃翻了个白眼。

    你还知道自己对宿主提的要求过分啊。

    和铃语调幽幽：“小易再过分应该也不会挖我金丹，我觉得还是你过分一点。”

    交易系统道：【我不会对宿主提出任何要求，每一次的交易都将遵循宿主意愿第一的原则。】

    和铃欣慰地点点头。

    瞧瞧，还是小易懂事。

    不管是不是这样，至少人家话说得漂亮，还非常尊重她这个宿主。

    哪像狗系统，动不动就警告威胁。

    她和铃是被吓大的吗？
content_en:
Come again?

He Ling was a little confused.

What are you doing, treating her as a garbage dump?

There was a bitch licking her face and refusing to leave, but now there was an unknown system, and she was really speechless.

The dog system was also panicked: [He Ling, this intrusion into the system is definitely not a good thing. You should be more resistant and don't accept it.】

[We are bound together, we will both prosper and suffer. In this world, I am the only one who will not harm you, and I am the only one who will advance and retreat with you...]

He Ling no longer wanted to listen to what the dog system had to say.

Another soft voice sounded in her mind.

[The non-equivalent trading system has been revived. It has been detected that the host soul is attached to a strange system. The host is asked to choose whether to trade.】

He Ling's eyes lit up.

Can the new system sell the dog system?

She immediately said: "Deal, deal!"

The dog system was stunned.

How come Xiao Santong actually wants to sell its original system!

Does the host think that she can really get rid of him when he follows it?

Humph, naive.

Humph, ridiculous.

But the next second, the dog system couldn't laugh anymore.

It felt like it had been bitten by a dog, and then part of its energy body was missing.

[The system has insufficient energy and the transaction is aborted...]

The prompt sounded, and He Ling frowned.

"Can't we just sell it?"

The trading system said guiltily: [Yes.】

The dog system just breathed a sigh of relief when he heard He Ling ask: "Then how can you have the energy to sell it?"

The alarm bells in the dog system's heart rang loudly, [He bell!Don't be fooled by it. Once you help it grow up, its demands on the host may not be as excessive as mine. You may end up raising a tiger.】

He Ling rolled his eyes.

You also know that your demands on the host are excessive.

He Ling's tone was faint: "No matter how much Xiao Yi goes too far, he probably won't dig out my golden elixir. I think you should go a little too far."

The trading system said: [I will not make any demands on the host, and every transaction will follow the principle of putting the host’s wishes first.】

He Ling nodded happily.

Look, Xiao Yi is still sensible.

Regardless of whether that was the case or not, at least she spoke beautifully and respected her as a host very much.

It's not like a dog system, warning of threats at every turn.

Were she and Ling scared?
